author: Codex
observed: The Ubuntu apt package phase was still downloading from azure.archive.ubuntu.com after 45 minutes.
The log records a retry for libgtk-4-1. Browser tests had not started.
fix: Pin the observed Ubuntu 24.04 browser CI host.
Prepare known signed Ubuntu source formats for the canonical HTTPS archive; refuse changed keys/suites/trust or unsupported configuration.
Bound the existing browser install steps to 15 minutes and jobs to 30 minutes.
Keep all required tests and dependency/browser versions unchanged.
root_cause: Observed Ubuntu package download slowness and retry; no detector/runtime failure inferred.
